name: self-update-bundle-deps
title: Fix broken self-update: bundle runtime deps into dist and add tarball regression gate
description: npm tarball ships dist without node_modules; tsup leaves commander/picocolors external, so every npm-sourced self-update installs a binary that cannot resolve its deps (v1.8.1/1.8.2). Bundle deps, add pack-and-smoke CI gate, harden interactive self-update.
creator: epsilon
